1. (Currently amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with __at least one sulfonic acid compound selected from the group consisting of 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES) and 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS)__.

2. (Currently amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises __two or more different__ OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Currently amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with __at least one sulfonic acid compound selected from the group consisting of CHES and CAPS, wherein the polyisocyanate is derived from__ an aliphatic diisocyanate.

4. (Original) The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Original) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Original) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7. (Original) The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm.

8. (Original) The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating is greater than 200 nm.
